content.value: A super speed beam warpers with a warping speed of 750 yds/min is preparing a standard way of 450 end. If the yarn count is 32's and overall efficiency is 90%, then calculate the followings-
(The length of warp on each beam is required to be 40000 yds., ignore wastages)
i) Total length of warp produced per day of 12 hours.
ii) No. of beam produced per day of 12 hours.
iii) Total weight of yarn in kg warped per drum.
iv) Weight of yarn on a beam in kg.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
